name: pie-chart
title: Pie chart
description: A pie or donut chart: one wedge per slice, sized to its share of the total. Slices take soft tints from a built-in palette (overridable per slice, or disableable to a neutral wash), labels sit outside on leader lines, inside the wedge, or nowhere, and a donut's centre reads the total at rest and the engaged slice while one is hovered, focused, or solely selected. A long tail can be rolled into one bucket that keeps its members reachable, the sweep can be narrowed into a gauge, and slices sort by input order or value. It fills the host's box on both axes, tolerates and reports partial mid-stream data, floats host-supplied hover detail beside the pointer, and makes every wedge a keyboard-focusable button with hover isolation and multi-selectable slices that ease out of the ring.
